metadata.title: Florian Bardin
metadata.description: As a computer science student at the IUT in Reims and a future engineering student at IMT Atlantique, I specialize in designing robust software solutions for the sovereign cloud and the space sector.

header.title: Committed to technological sovereignty, from <h>Cloud</h> to <h>space</h>.
header.subtitle: Currently a student in Reims and a future engineering student at IMT Atlantique, I design simple and robust tools. I have a strong interest in sovereign cloud and the space sector, two essential pillars for ensuring the independence and security of our strategic areas.

highschool.title: High School Diploma 📚
highschool.desc: Mathematics, Engineering Sciences and Computer Sciences

portfolio.name: florianbardin.dev
portfolio.description: Portfolio built with Next.js, designed for performance and SEO (SSR), with full multilingual support (i18n).

apod.name: APOD Viewer
apod.description: A React application that uses the APOD API, featuring a search history system dating back to 1995 and performance optimization via custom hooks (debouncing).

vitis.name: Vitis API
vitis.description: A robust Spring Boot API implementing clean architecture, dynamic filtering (JPA Specs), standardized error reporting (RFC 7807), and secure DTO mapping.

foehn.name: Foehn
foehn.description: A self-hosted Go-based PaaS platform that automates the deployment of Git projects using a custom orchestration daemon, an integrated reverse proxy (Caddy), and a CLI.

contact.heading: Get in touch 📲
contact.description: I would be pleased to learn more about your projects. To do so, you can reach me on <linkedin>Linkedin</linkedin> or directly via email at <email>fbardin51@gmail.com</email>.
